# Open Learning Hub

> A practical, self-paced learning academy for workforce management, Excel, Power BI, Python and Power Automate.

## Primary pages
- https://swapnild007.github.io/Open-learning-hub/
- https://swapnild007.github.io/Open-learning-hub/wfm-glossary.html

## Learning tracks
- Workforce Management: glossary, forecasting, Erlang staffing, scheduling and multi-channel capacity planning.
- Excel: formulas, dashboards, PivotTables, Power Query and Power Pivot.
- Power BI: data modelling, DAX, dashboards and performance.
- Python: programming foundations, data analysis, testing and automation.
- Power Automate: workflow design, approvals, reliability and governance.

## Content status
The site currently provides a course catalogue and curriculum maps plus a standalone WFM glossary. Curriculum maps are not equivalent to complete courses. Lesson depth, examples, labs and assessments are being built incrementally.

## Quality notes
Educational content should state assumptions, show reproducible examples, cite authoritative references and distinguish illustrative formulas from organisation-specific KPI definitions.
